<function name="HasEnemyMemory" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>Polls the enemy memory to check if the NPC has any memory of given enemy.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2020.06.24</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="enemy" type="Entity" default="GetEnemy()">The entity to test.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="eluded" type="boolean">If we have any memory on given enemy.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
